title: Nightshift Scarecrow
mood: haunted, patient, tender, slow dawn that never lands

verse 1.lyrics: Straw in my chest | lan-tern-light | count-ing ev-ery row | all night long | The crows come down | hum-ming low | all the words I knew | stay a-wake

chorus.lyrics: Sun-rise nev-er comes I'll stay a-wake just in case Some-one might walk back I'll hold my post in the dark

verse 2.lyrics: Wind in my coat | pock-ets full | of keys to no door | I don't mind | Don't feel sor-ry | I'm just straw | crows all know my name | and I wait

chorus 2.lyrics: Sun-rise nev-er comes I'll stay a-wake just in case Some-one might walk back I'll hold my post in the dark

bridge.lyrics: Come home | come home | I'm still right here

final chorus.lyrics: Sun-rise nev-er comes I'll stay a-wake just in case Some-one might walk back I'll hold my post in the dark

notes: A scarecrow hums low under a walking bass, then the bass drops out in the chorus so the dawn lands on nothing but air. One short cracked scream in the bridge, then the last chorus lets go.
idea:
A scarecrow standing in the night shift fields, stitched and tired, humming to the crows. Slow build, low bass under the verses, the chorus opens up like dawn that never quite arrives. Breathy and a little haunted, then it lets go. Vesper's idea: Love it. Let the bassline walk a descending minor pattern under the verses, then drop the bass to a single open string during the chorus so the dawn lands on nothing but air.
